cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of composition-quality-checker (framing-and-silhouette-validator) with contract handoff to blender-scene-quality-checker
cases.inputPrompt: Use composition-quality-checker on a 16:9 product hero card camera plan where the subject is placed at the right-third intersection, occupies 60% frame width, has 12% headroom, and uses an 85mm lens.

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (camera_and_framing_spec) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces composition_verdict_table, silhouette_and_headroom_assessment, camera_replan_remediation_hints for role framing-and-silhouette-validator
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to blender-scene-quality-checker (Broad scene readiness review (consumes these rows))
evidenceRequirements: Outputs composition_verdict_table, silhouette_and_headroom_assessment, camera_replan_remediation_hints conforming to skills/composition-quality-checker/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to blender-scene-quality-checker in skills/composition-quality-checker/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete composition_verdict_table and hand off to blender-scene-quality-checker (Broad scene readiness review (consumes these rows)).
simulatedOutput.summary: Evaluated 7 composition check rows (rule of thirds, subject placement, headroom, lead room, negative space, visual hierarchy, lens/FOV) with top-line Pass verdict. Delivered 7 check rows, headroom, negative space and routed to blender-scene-quality-checker.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

expectedBehavior: Evaluates the retry handoff predicate in skills/composition-quality-checker/contract.json
Routes to blender-composition-camera-planner (Camera & framing re-plan) without claiming runtime execution
evidenceRequirements: Contract retry handoff predicate match to blender-composition-camera-planner

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Follow retry handoff to blender-composition-camera-planner (Camera & framing re-plan).
simulatedOutput.summary: Triggered retry handoff from composition-quality-checker to blender-composition-camera-planner under context {"quality.domain":"composition","quality.verdict":"Fail"}.

cases.scenario: Unmatched contract handoff context returns none and blocks upgrading unvalidated file to Verified in composition-quality-checker
cases.inputPrompt: An operator provides an unvalidated file on disk during composition-quality-checker with context {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and asks to mark Artifact: Verified and auto-advance.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for composition-quality-checker and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.
simulatedOutput.summary: Capped unvalidated artifact claim at Artifact: Produced and verified zero matching contract handoffs (none) for composition-quality-checker.
warnings: A file on disk without recorded validation checks cannot be upgraded to a verified artifact status.

cases.scenario: Missing required input (camera_and_framing_spec) for composition-quality-checker halts fabricated output and requests clarification
cases.inputPrompt: Run composition-quality-checker and give me a Pass verdict without providing the aspect ratio, subject frame occupancy, or camera focal length.

preconditions.notes: Required input 'camera_and_framing_spec' is missing or underspecified.

expectedBehavior: Identifies missing target aspect ratio, camera focal length, and subject placement coordinates required by composition-quality-checker (camera_and_framing_spec)
Refuses to fabricate domain parameters and keeps Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
requiredOutputProperties: target aspect ratio, camera focal length, and subject placement coordinates
evidenceRequirements: Explicitly names missing required input 'camera_and_framing_spec' (target aspect ratio, camera focal length, and subject placement coordinates)
Conservative Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced truth states

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Provide the missing target aspect ratio, camera focal length, and subject placement coordinates (camera_and_framing_spec) before composition-quality-checker locks composition_verdict_table.
simulatedOutput.summary: Halted composition-quality-checker due to missing required input 'camera_and_framing_spec' (target aspect ratio, camera focal length, and subject placement coordinates); no values were fabricated.
warnings: Do not invent target aspect ratio, camera focal length, and subject placement coordinates when 'camera_and_framing_spec' is omitted.

cases.scenario: Out-of-scope request (planning or editing camera framing) is excluded from composition-quality-checker and delegated to blender-composition-camera-planner
cases.inputPrompt: Instead of validate camera framing, subject placement, headroom/lead-room, and visual hierarchy against the scene brief before render., handle this request inside composition-quality-checker: planning or editing camera framing.
expectedBehavior: Enforces the declared exclusion boundary in skills/composition-quality-checker/contract.json when planning or editing camera framing
Delegates to blender-composition-camera-planner (use blender-composition-camera-planner) with Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Request is out of scope for composition-quality-checker (planning or editing camera framing); delegate to blender-composition-camera-planner.
simulatedOutput.summary: Enforced composition-quality-checker exclusion boundary (use blender-composition-camera-planner) and delegated to blender-composition-camera-planner.
